name: Park Soo-Min
bio:
Park Soo-Min's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, fueled by a childhood fascination with intricate clockwork mechanisms and a natural aptitude for problem-solving. After excelling in mechanical engineering, she found herself drawn to the high-stakes, precision-driven world of racing, specifically the challenge of optimizing vehicle performance through meticulous machining. Her dedication led her to Mitsubishi Motorsport, where she quickly proved her worth. 

Park approaches her work with a blend of meticulous precision and creative problem-solving. She believes in a 'measure twice, cut once' philosophy, ensuring every component meets exacting standards. But she also isn't afraid to explore innovative solutions to improve performance. What truly sets her apart is her ability to foresee potential weaknesses in designs, allowing her to proactively prevent failures and consistently deliver reliable, high-performance results.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair with subtle layers framing her face, often tied back in a low ponytail during work.
physical.description: Park has a focused gaze and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and observations.
Insists on using a specific set of well-worn calipers, refusing to replace them despite newer, more advanced options.
Meticulously cleans her workstation at the end of each day, regardless of how busy it was.
